name: Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate
description: This badge signifies the successful completion of the Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate on Coursera. Earners have demonstrated proficiency in collecting, transforming, and organizing data for analysis, using tools such as spreadsheets, SQL, R, and Tableau to uncover insights and make data-driven decisions.

criteria.narrative: Complete all eight courses in the Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate program on Coursera, demonstrating foundational data analytics skills and practical project experience.

alignment.targetDescription: Learn to prepare, process, and analyze data using tools such as spreadsheets and SQL.
Learn to visualize and communicate data findings using Tableau and R programming.
